Rina: hey all, Rina here 65; first on-call next week. quick Qs about a few policy/access things.
Theo: welcome Rina! short answers :)
Rina: 1) my dashboards (grafana) 403s. i requested access but not sure who approves runbook dashboards.
infra-it: dashboard groups are owned by the service team. open an access request at https://infra.redwood/access and tag the service alias (ingest@redwood). we auto-approve read for oncall role.
Rina: 2) i travel a lot 65; can i swap shifts remotely and how do we ensure coverage?
Theo: use PD swap and add a note "travel-swap". for swaps <48h you must confirm with your buddy and cc @sre-training. PD blocks swaps that create gaps. if you need a one-off cover, DM @sre-training for emergency coverage.
Rina: 3) can i set Slack DND during sleep hours without missing pages?
infra-it: don't set Slack DND for oncall duration. instead use PD mobile quiet hours mapping: profile -> contact -> schedule overrides. Slack DND will mute messages but PD will still page your phone.
Rina: 4) security incidents: who do we @ for potential data-exfil?
security-oncall: for suspected data-exfil or credentials compromise, immediately @security-oncall and @ops-security and open a Sev1 incident. follow the runbook: redact logs, run `tools/redact.sh`, and include sanitized bundle link.
Rina: 5) runbook edits: found typo in a critical command. can i push a hotfix?
Theo: yes, small urgent fixes are okay with `runbook: hotfix` MR and ping the owners for post-hoc review. if the change alters commands, add a rollback note.
sre-training: we'll assign you a buddy for your first two live pages. ping us if you want a shadow on the swap.
oncall-bot: Reminder: finish oncall quickstart: https://internal.redwood/oncall-quickstart
Rina: thanks everyone! i'll open the access request and schedule my swap now.
